reddit_urls.title: Reddit URLs
reddit_urls.description: Subreddit or search URLs to scan, e.g. https://www.reddit.com/r/SillyTavernAI/top/?t=month. Passed through to trudax/reddit-scraper-lite as startUrls. Leave empty to skip Reddit.

substack_publications.title: Substack publication URLs
substack_publications.description: Base URLs of Substack publications, e.g. https://example.substack.com. Read via each publication's public /feed RSS endpoint - no Apify cost. Leave empty to skip Substack.

max_items_per_source.title: Max items per source
max_items_per_source.description: Caps both the Reddit sub-actor's maxItems/maxPostCount and the number of Substack RSS entries read per publication. Keeps Apify pay-per-result cost bounded for unattended monthly runs - do not raise without owner approval.
